row.body: A meal list says the group has enough food to wait for a boat; its water line is labelled for the field crew and left unopened.
row.title: Enough food for the crossing

cites.quote: Meet me here Tonya! Got enough food.

sidecar.gloss: A group waits for transport while field water remains unused.
sidecar.rival_reading: An evacuation party could stage food and water for a boat trip; the note does not identify why the water was set aside.
